ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with approximately 35-40% high-intensity (white/gray) mottled coverage across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) central zone spanning from the peduncle to the median notch; high-intensity (white/gray) striated mottling distributed across both lateral lobes; high-intensity focal spots concentrated at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe apex height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the continuous boundary; multiple peaks and valleys with amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels; most pronounced irregularity on the medial edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, upwardly-angled lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular clusters of high-intensity pixels (acorn barnacles) localized on the far outer margins of both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, parallel, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization on lateral margins; significant vertical linear scarring on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique fine-grained, horizontal striated texture within the white pigmentation regions across both lobes.
